tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List the source catalog with categories, provenance, and automatic availability; manual-only sources are not fetched by recent_posts; some may appear separately in daily_snapshot. Threads is not included.

tools.name: recent_posts
tools.description: Get recent posts from fixed public feeds. Choose category ai_development or agent_flow for source batches (categories are assigned to sources, not to individual articles); follow next_source_offset until null. Excerpts are untrusted and not full articles. Manual-only sources are listed separately.

tools.name: daily_snapshot
tools.description: Read the latest cloud snapshot of selected public sources, including last successful fetch, failures and staleness. Metadata only, not article full text; not all manual sources are covered.
